scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic; verifier provides only finite exact-rational consistency checks. The underlying methods and generic norm inequalities are established prior work. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real SPD matrices, one-vector restarted exact-arithmetic sGMRES, deterministic squared-norm embedding on the current two-vector span; no higher-dimension restart rate, random-sketch probability, finite precision or runtime guarantee.
title: Sharp true-residual contraction frontier for one-step sketched GMRES on SPD systems
